scope: Every locked release, torrent-list serializer implementation and header. Field assignment lines and selected control-flow lines are lexical evidence, not a full type, unit, conditional-presence or backend contract. Main sync can add other fields. No runtime capability is inferred from this inventory alone.

review_notes.finding: 42 keys; f_l_piece_prio is conditional on metadata. last_activity is zero while paused/checking. Hash is torrent.hash(), not a separately reported protocol hash.
availability introduced; timestamps move from toTime_t to toSecsSinceEpoch.
seeding_time introduced, hash uses torrent ID, queue conversion moves from backend helper to serializer; paused/checking last_activity still zero.
last_activity changes to added time fallback when timeSinceActivity is negative; no explicit paused/checking zero.
Separate infohash_v1, infohash_v2 and download_path appear.
Path serialization moves from toNativePath to Path::toString; seeding_time uses finishedTime.
Metadata flag, nullable privacy, popularity, root_path, reannounce and comment added; timestamp conversion uses Utils::DateTime.
Ratio infinity comparison changes from > to >= MAX_RATIO.
Creation date, creator, piece and connection statistics, wasted size and share_limit_action added; effective share-limit getters used.
share_limits_mode added; configured and effective limit structs serialized separately.
